title: RapidTO Dufferin (July 2025): the 29 Dufferin stop at Croatia St removed
body: City staff report for City Council item 2025.EX25.4
status_note: City Council adopted RapidTO on Dufferin Street on July 23 and 24, 2025 (item 2025.EX25.4). The Croatia St stop no longer appears in the November 2026 TTC schedule file; Eversfield Rd, also proposed, still does. The 'before' stop is reconstructed where Croatia St meets the route. Found by the research agent.
quotes: TTC has recommended one stop for removal at Croatia Street.
